items.article_text:
Laureise has a great body but the body checking disguised as empowerment is exhausting. Body neutrality, less lip filler and fewer body checks would be more genuine empowerment.

Looking to build real friendships. I am very loyal and supportive, I'll always be there in the good and hard times. I like discussing interesting topics or yapping whatever we feel like. I'm into philosophy, gaming, gym and traveling. I like going to concerts and love music in general. I like the beach and water sports, skiing and cycling. I really like cooking and learning about different cuisines.
 I'm a very good-natured guy and a huge animal lover. When it comes to music, my absolute favorite band is Pearl Jam. The games I like are mainly RDR2, GTA, Hitman, Age of Empires, and The Sims, and for movies or TV, I usually gravitate toward thrillers, spy stories, and philosophical plots.
